values: 吟唱技能，对全体友军持续产生治疗，受到响应的“花灵”将会对敌方全体造成伤害。
Solise chants a spell to continuously heal all allies. Affected Bulbsprites will deal damage to all enemies.
娑丽丝进入生灵亲和姿态，并产生3个覆盖全场的治疗波纹，治疗波纹会对波及到的友军施加140% + 22% ATK的治疗。当友方“花灵”接触到治疗波纹时，会立即响应，以被祝福的友军为中心向全场扩散一道水环，对所有敌人造成30% + 3% ATK的伤害。本技能释放期间，娑丽丝获得霸体。

Solise enters a nature-attuned state, releasing 3 waves of healing across the battlefield that each restores 140% + 22% ATK HP to affected allies. If an allied Bulbsprite is affected by one of her healing waves, it sends a water ring from its host's position, dealing 30% + 3% ATK damage to all enemies. Solise becomes unaffected while casting this skill.
为己方全体非召唤物友军附加“芽种”，满足条件时将会成长为“花灵”，会为被祝福单位持续提供治疗和增益效果。
Solise sends a Bulb to each non-summoned ally. When certain conditions are met, the Bulb will bloom into a Bulbsprite. In either form, it continuously heals its host and grants buffs.

战斗开始时，娑丽丝为所有己方非召唤物友军送上自然祝福，将“芽种”送至他们身边，“芽种”每3秒会为被祝福友军提供40% + 10% ATK治疗。本技能释放期间，娑丽丝获得霸体。
战斗中，“芽种”会吸收该友军受到的治疗溢出，当溢出值达到娑丽丝初始攻击力600%时，“芽种”会成长为“花灵”，并额外使该友军永久提升娑丽丝初始攻击力15% + 1.5%的攻击力。当娑丽丝被击败时，“花灵”及“芽种”带来的效果不会消失，但无法再进行提升，也无法再响应娑丽丝。

When a battle starts, Solise sends a Bulb to each non-summoned ally, blessing them with nature's gift. These Bulbs provide 40% + 10% ATK healing to their host every 3s. Solise becomes unaffected while casting this skill.
During battle, each Bulb can store any excess healing its host receives. When this stored healing reaches 600% of Solise's initial ATK, the Bulb blooms into a Bulbsprite. The Bulbsprite permanently increases its host's ATK by a value equal to 15% + 1.5% of Solise's initial ATK. Even when Solise is defeated in battle, the effects from her Bulbs and Bulbsprites stay active. But they can't grow or respond to her anymore.
“芽种”提供的治疗量提升至60% + 10% ATK。
Increases the healing provided by a Bulb to 60% + 10% ATK.
“芽种”提供的治疗量提升至80% + 10% ATK。
Increases the healing provided by a Bulb to 80% + 10% ATK.
“芽种”提供的治疗量提升至100% + 10% ATK。
Increases the healing provided by a Bulb to 100% + 10% ATK.
为最虚弱的数名友军恢复生命值。已有“花灵”跟随的友军额外获得护盾效果。
Solise heals the weakest allies. If a healed ally has a Bulbsprite with them, they also gain a shield.
娑丽丝改良植物药剂中的魔力，在最虚弱的2名友军身上绽放花朵，使其回复190% + 25% ATK的生命值。若受到治疗的友军身边已有“花灵”跟随，则“花灵”会立刻响应娑丽丝，为被祝福友军施加一个可抵御250% + 25% ATK伤害的永久护盾，护盾最高不超过900% ATK。

Solise infuses her magic into potions to help restore 190% + 25% ATK HP to the weakest 2 allies. When Solise heals an ally who already has a Bulbsprite with them, her healing grants a permanent shield that absorbs 250% + 25% ATK damage. The shield value cannot exceed 900% ATK.
提升自身攻击力，场上有“花灵”时额外提升攻击力。
Increases ATK, with an extra ATK increase when a Bulbsprite is present.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升10%。场上存在友方“花灵”时，自身的攻击力额外提升5%。
Increases ATK by 10% during battle. Gains an extra 5% ATK when an allied Bulbsprite is present.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升12%。场上存在友方“花灵”时，自身的攻击力额外提升8%。
Increases ATK by 12% during battle. Gains an extra 8% ATK when an allied Bulbsprite is present.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升14%。场上存在友方“花灵”时，自身的攻击力额外提升11%。
Increases ATK by 14% during battle. Gains an extra 11% ATK when an allied Bulbsprite is present.
“芽种”成长为“花灵”后，将会吸收治疗溢出效果，提供更多的增益。
Once a Bulb blooms into a Bulbsprite, absorbing more excess healing will allow it to grant more buffs.
当"芽种"成长为"花灵"时，将会为被祝福友军带来一次永久性的祝福，使其提升娑丽丝初始攻击力4%的护甲和魔抗。“花灵”状态下，被祝福友军累计获得相当于娑丽丝初始攻击力600%的治疗溢出时，会使“花灵”永久升级，并使该友军额外提升娑丽丝初始攻击力7%的攻击力。“花灵”最多可以通过这种方式升级3次。

When a Bulb blooms into a Bulbsprite, it grants its host a permanent blessing, increasing their Phys & Magic DEF by a value equal to 4% of Solise's initial ATK.
When the total excess healing a Bulbsprite's host receives reaches 600% of Solise's initial ATK, the Bulbsprite permanently levels up, and its host gains ATK equal to 7% of Solise's initial ATK. The Bulbsprite can be upgraded this way up to 3 times.
“芽种”成长为“花灵”后，该友军获得的护甲和魔抗提升至娑丽丝初始攻击力的6%。
Once a Bulb blooms into a Bulbsprite, its host gains Phys & Magic DEF equal to 6% of Solise's initial ATK.
当“花灵”升至满级后，会立即为被祝福成员带来永久性的最大生命值提升，提升值为娑丽丝初始攻击力的450%。
After a Bulbsprite reaches its max level, it permanently increases its host's max HP by 450% of Solise's initial ATK.
“芽种”成长为“花灵”后，该友军获得的护甲和魔抗提升至娑丽丝初始攻击力的8%。
Once a Bulb blooms into a Bulbsprite, its host gains Phys & Magic DEF equal to 8% of Solise's initial ATK.
“花灵”响应的伤害，将会附带累计的治疗溢出值一定比例的额外伤害。
When a Bulbsprite deals damage, it deals extra damage equal to a portion of the total excess healing it has stored.
娑丽丝释放“万物有灵”时，“花灵”产生的伤害，将会额外附加其“花灵”状态期间已累积治疗溢出量的2%。最多不能超过娑丽丝初始攻击力的110%。

While Solise is casting Life's Embrace, damage dealt by Bulbsprite triggers extra damage equal to 2% of the total excess healing it has stored during its Bulbsprite phase. The extra damage cannot exceed 110% of Solise's initial ATK.
